snippet_primary: "El modelo de negocio de Kichink resulta disruptivo frente a otras plataformas, pues a diferencia de cobrar un precio de entrada o mensual, solicitan una comisión en promedio de 7.5 por ciento por cada transacción."
subject_exact: El Financiero article (elfinanciero.com.mx, ~2016) describes Kichink's business model as disruptive: charges an average commission of 7.5% per transaction rather than an entry fee or monthly subscription; contrasts with competing platforms that charge upfront or recurring fees
local_qualifiers: Kichink: avg 7.5% commission per transaction; no entry or monthly fee; described as disruptive model
